drivers.variant_notes: Oliver's two-2732 free-play set keeps one credit after the first coin with S17–19 on. The 02 revision appears in player one at boot.

Quench's February 2019 Free Play+ uses two 2 KiB images in the stock BY17 map. S18/S19 enable free play, with S17 off counting down and on clearing credits at a new game. Closed-switch test cycles all closures. A dropped target scores once until reset.

drivers.description: Mata Hari (Free Play and MODified rules)
drivers.variant_notes: Quench V22 uses two 4 KiB images in the BY35 address map on a suitably configured MPU. S17/S18 enable free play, S19 off selects six-digit virtual millions, and S29 extends the award table. Settings 13–16 control the new features. In Credit Reset (13:3=0), Audit 12 retains the highest end-of-game credit balance before Match.

drivers.description: Mata Hari (Free Play and MODified rules, 7-digit)
drivers.variant_notes: Same V22 ROM bytes and 4 KiB MPU addressing as matahard. DIP 19 on and a separate millions-digit strobe to all four aftermarket seven-digit player displays. Stock credits and match/ball fields remain two digits each.
Factory six-digit set, 2 KiB U2 and U6 images in the BY17 map.

Oliver's standalone PCK-Bally revision 7 uses two 2732 EPROMs. S31/S32 set balls, S25 and S26 together replenish one credit from initialized zero, S27 shows credits and S28 enables Match. The A+B skill shot advances twice. S23 selects the top saucer schedule. See the operator chart and verified credit read paths.

mechanisms.behavior: One ball rests on the outhole wire below the flippers at startup. The ROM serves it to the right shooter alley on coil 7 and waits for the contact to open. On drain, contact 8 closes again and the ROM counts bonus and advances or repeats the turn. The shooter plunger and arch gate are passive.
mechanisms.label: Outhole and shooter feed

mechanisms.behavior: The cup and lip hold one ball. Contact 32 stays closed until the kick clears the cup. Stock play scores 3,000 per visit and uses S23 for its multiplier schedule. With S23 off, visits 2, 3 and 4 award the multipliers. Coil 1 kicks the ball into the upper field.
mechanisms.label: Top-centre saucer

mechanisms.behavior: Four independent D, C, B, A targets bottom to top. Each spring biases its face against a catch and pulls it down after a hit releases the catch. Each latched target closes one leaf switch. A side-mounted coil lifts a shared reset arm and raises all four faces and opens their contacts. At serve the banks reset. In the stock trace one full bank stays down until the other completes, then both coils fire. Quench patches suppress the extra score from a momentary reopening and reclosing of a down target.
mechanisms.label: Left four-drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: Four independent D, C, B, A targets bottom to top. Each spring biases its face against a catch and pulls it down after a hit releases the catch. Each latched target closes one leaf switch. A side-mounted coil lifts a shared reset arm and raises all four faces and opens their contacts. At serve the banks reset. In the stock trace one full bank stays down until the other completes, then both coils fire. Quench patches suppress the extra score from a momentary reopening and reclosing of a down target.
mechanisms.label: Right four-drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: Two parallel 10-point rebound contacts behind the banks. Either momentary closure gives the same matrix address. The upper VPX sling events represent the contacts.
mechanisms.label: Upper target-area rebound contacts

mechanisms.behavior: The ball briefly closes the contact. With play enabled the ROM pulses this assembly's coil. The conversion uses native simulated rebound geometry.
mechanisms.label: Bottom left thumper bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The ball briefly closes the contact. With play enabled the ROM pulses this assembly's coil. The conversion uses native simulated rebound geometry.
mechanisms.label: Top left thumper bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The ball briefly closes the contact. With play enabled the ROM pulses this assembly's coil. The conversion uses native simulated rebound geometry.

mechanisms.behavior: The ball briefly closes the contact. With play enabled the ROM pulses this assembly's coil. The conversion uses native simulated rebound geometry.
mechanisms.label: Left slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: The ball briefly closes the contact. With play enabled the ROM pulses this assembly's coil. The conversion uses native simulated rebound geometry.
mechanisms.label: Right slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button and K1 contact energize the dual-winding assembly. Local EOS opens at end of stroke and the return spring lowers the flipper at release. PinMAME publishes one held enabled-button pair for the assembly.
mechanisms.label: Right flipper

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button and K1 contact energize the dual-winding assembly. Local EOS opens at end of stroke and the return spring lowers the flipper at release. PinMAME publishes one held enabled-button pair for the assembly.
mechanisms.label: Left flipper

mechanisms.behavior: One backbox relay has two contacts, one for each local flipper circuit. The ROM asserts its driver when play is enabled and drops it on tilt.
mechanisms.label: K1 flipper enable

mechanisms.behavior: The plumb bob, roll cage and weighted panel contact parallel into 7. A closure cancels the active turn and drops K1 until a new turn. The separate slam contact on 16 restarts the power-up sequence. The service documentation allows additional slam contacts.
mechanisms.label: Tilt contacts

mechanisms.behavior: Passive ball gate in the upper right shooter arch. It lets a launched ball enter the upper playfield and restricts return to the shooter alley.
mechanisms.label: Shooter lane ball gate

mechanisms.behavior: Four switched chime coils provide scoring and tunes. The driver declares no sound board.
mechanisms.label: Cabinet chime assembly

mechanisms.behavior: The backbox knocker is a momentary coil with a physical strike. It is separate from the four chimes.
mechanisms.label: Replay knocker

mechanisms.behavior: One continuous lockout coil serves the coin door, which carries right and left chutes and a provision for a centre chute. The chute contacts report accepted coins independently.
mechanisms.label: Coin door lockout

physical.notes: One side-mounted coil lifts the shared reset arm. A6 draws two symbols on the branch. The factory parts count and the photographed assemblies establish one fitted coil per bank. The placement is an approximate actuator effect projection.

The factory harness marks this branch N/U. Whole-byte writes to the stock A/B strobe incidentally drive this bit. The stock all-lamps test also sweeps it. In matatest, the revision 7 attract handler at $13c2–$13ca complements the whole strobe byte at $0203, including this bit. Lamps 4 and 20 change together in all 26 follow-up traces. Every spare edge shares a callback timestamp with lamp 36 or 52 in the 17 traces for the other drivers. The nine matatest traces share 12 of 42 or 15 of 51 spare-edge timestamps with those fitted lamps.
